doc.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Compliments from Bill Evans and Stan Getz
summary: Bill Evans liked his lines on the Soupy Sales show and Getz praised his scat singing.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: There’s some other good stories that I remember, compliments that I just wanted to mention that I’m proud of like when I think of it. There’s one, I was doing the “Soupy Sales Show” in Detroit. And I was walking down the street and I run into Bill Evans. And he says “I saw you on the ‘Soupy Sales Show’ I really dig your lines.” Which was great.
Isn’t that interesting that he would pick that out, from Soupy Sales.
Isn’t that something? I guess it was in Detroit I guess and maybe he was in Detroit at the same time. No not Soupy Sales, Bill Evans told me.

The other thing, I was doing a scat thing. One of Stan Getz, he used to hang out with Morey Stein, so I did a thing and I was scat singing. Morey had died and there was a Alfonse’s, it’s a club. So afterwards Stan Getz told me he says, “Man you sound better than — you’re one of the greatest scat singers.” That’s what he told me. You know so that was a nice compliment.
